title: Required operator policy for a funding and China macro review
description: Configuration schema, not a pre-approved trading policy. Bind exact returned series and independent calendar-aware age limits before calling assess for each product group. Successful tool delivery alone is not input eligibility.

decision_horizon.description: The operator's specific evaluation task and horizon, not a guarantee of trade suitability.

funding.description: Choose exact Seiche funding series, units and a reviewed source calendar. A daily observation is assessed against its own expected publication schedule.

china_macro.description: Choose exact admitted Palimpsest series. Monthly/quarterly observations, combined January/February releases, revisions and database delay need their own policy; do not reuse a daily funding threshold.

units.description: Every selected product-qualified series must have an independently checked unit; schema structure alone does not prove matching.

max_observation_age_seconds.description: Set for this source/task after reviewing publication cadence, holidays and expected database lag.
